run_generate_fake_smallnorb: run the script to generate fake Smallnorb dataset files in the test data directory
write_binary_matrix: write a numpy array as a little-endian binary matrix file with magic codes and shape metadata
create_chunk_fake_data: create fake dat, cat, and info binary matrix files for a Smallnorb-like dataset chunk
generate_fake_dataset: generate a fake Smallnorb dataset with training and testing chunks in the fake_examples directory
run_main_cli: run the Smallnorb fake data generation CLI with an optional tfds_dir argument
